The '[P]' tag on T017a is likely incorrect if it must strictly precede T017b in a single-threaded execution flow, or the tasks should be merged to avoid false parallelism.

The ordering implies these refinements can be planned, but the execution order is impossible until the Phase 3 data pipeline is fixed.
